body:
## Intent

Repair our stalled upstream Firstmate pull request 5645 ("contributions with older gh CLI"): the branch is dirty against current upstream main (base f5930603) even though all its checks are green, and our own pipeline renamed its title to the generic "chore: update pull request" at 2026-10-01T13:21:41Z, losing the descriptive title. Restore both: rebase the existing PR branch onto current upstream main through the supported path, and restore the descriptive title. The recorded details for 5645 are: our contributions-on-older-gh fix, head 9aa0e8a8, 7 commits across bin/fm-contributions.sh and four test files, all checks green including the two portable-serial jobs that had failed on 2026-09-29 and both Greptile P2 threads resolved, while GitHub showed it conflicting with current main and carrying the generic title; a Greptile finding about tests/fm-calm-pi-extension.test.sh that appeared on it is misattributed and belongs to 5848. The upstream repo is kunchenguid/firstmate - never merge there; our PRs are poll-only and maintainer-owned for landing. The rebase was published with a force-with-lease update of the existing pull-request branch with the pre-force head recorded, and the pipeline is run against the published rebased head so the attestation rebinds to that head through a real pipeline run rather than a hand-edited body claim.

## What Changed

- Replace `gh api --slurp` with local JSON page assembly so contribution polling supports older GitHub CLI versions.
- Bound retrieval and page assembly together, preserving prior observations when the read budget expires.
- Expand pagination and timeout regression coverage, strengthen Pi rendering and watcher assertions, and improve test fixture isolation and cleanup.

## Risk Assessment

✅ Low: The compatibility fix is bounded, preserves observation and timeout semantics, and introduces no substantiated defects or source-visible intent contradictions.

## Testing

Focused contributions, PR security, Pi consumer, and adapted remote fixture checks passed. Genuine old/current gh live scenarios reproduced the baseline defect and verified pagination, signals, failure recovery, timeouts, and read-only behavior, with regenerated CLI/state evidence. GitHub readback confirmed the restored title and rebased history. No product UI changed, so no screenshot was captured. Force-with-lease execution proof and final attestation rebinding remain with the outer executor.

- Live validation: ✅ go - 10 of 10 scenarios driven live against the product

| Scenario | Result | Live | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Poll a PR using gh 2.45.0 and gh 2.83.2: collect every page and acknowledge maintainer signals without repeated wakes | ✅ pass | live | live-transcript.json; old-gh-pr and modern-gh-pr persisted records |
| Poll an issue using old gh: retain later-page comments and ready-for-pr transitions through acknowledgement | ✅ pass | live | live-transcript.json; old-gh-issue persisted records |
| Receive malformed JSON on a later page: preserve the prior observation, report failure once, and recover | ✅ pass | live | live-transcript.json; corrupt persisted records |
| Receive HTTP 503 on a later page: preserve coherent state and suppress repeated failure notifications | ✅ pass | live | live-transcript.json; http-error persisted records |
| Change the PR head during observation: reject the inconsistent observation and recover on a stable read | ✅ pass | live | live-transcript.json; changed persisted records |
| Delay page assembly beyond its bound: preserve record bytes, emit no false wake, and terminate assembler children | ✅ pass | live | live-transcript.json; slow-assembly persisted records |
| Run the generated authenticated contribution check: surface later-page signals once | ✅ pass | live | live-transcript.json; registered-check persisted records |
| Run the base executable with genuine gh 2.45.0: reproduce the compatibility failure that the changed executable resolves | ✅ pass | live | live-transcript.json; before-fix persisted records |
| Observe contributions without issuing forge mutations or merging | ✅ pass | live | live-http-requests.json |
| Inspect existing PR 5645: descriptive title restored, published history contains f5930603, PR remains mergeable and unmerged | ✅ pass | live | repair-pr-readback.txt; repair-rebase-readback.txt; repair-force-push-readback.txt |
